sections.title: Free time, invitations, and modals
body: Use spela fotboll, läsa böcker, lyssna på musik, gå på bio, simma, träna.
Include day, time, place, and what to bring.
The sj-sound varies by region; recognise sj/skj/stj and imitate your local model.

sections.title: Modal plus bare infinitive
body: After vill, kan, ska and måste, use the infinitive without att.
Vill du …? invites; Kan du …? asks ability; Ska vi …? suggests a joint plan.
Accept with Ja, gärna. Decline with Tyvärr … and offer an alternative.

assignment.title: Episode 15 mission: Free time, invitations, and modals
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: Hear twice and answer: Which alternative day?

READ: Read for purpose and detail. Answer: What must participants bring?

SPEAK: Invite, respond to a problem, and agree a new time. Try once unaided, then improve one detail.

WRITE: Write an invitation with activity, time, place, and reply request. Check word order, forms, and purpose.

TRANSFER: Decline and propose another day.

RETURN: Combine each modal with an infinitive.
assignment.model:
Speaking: Vill du fika fredag? Tyvärr, jag arbetar. Kan vi ses lördag i stället?
Writing: Vill du simma på lördag kl. 14? Vi ses vid simhallen. Kan du komma?

takeaways: Use: Vill du följa med och simma på lördag?
